name: Adolence: City of Sin
Adolence·罪恶之都
Adolence: City of Sin
mods.author: 自然常数也有人用? and the Adolence team; port by Steel Tide
description: The city police and the troops that come to their aid, their cruisers, tanks and helicopters, and the dead they are fighting: bred from nests you can place yourself, and rising again from the police they kill.
都市警力与前来增援的部队、他们的警车、坦克和直升机，以及他们要对付的死者——从你亲手放置的巢穴中繁殖，被它们杀死的警察也会尸变。

The city police and the troops that come to their aid, their cruisers, tanks and helicopters, and the dead they are fighting: bred from nests you can place yourself, and rising again from the police they kill.

name: FG Rusted League
FG 铁锈联盟
FG Rusted League
mods.author: 空中之主 (art by 有人, 基卡 and SS元首); port by Steel Tide
description: FG Rusted League, ported from its Rusted Warfare build with its author's permission: the whole army redrawn in black and acid green — Grizzly and Prism tanks, Kirov airships, Patriot batteries — and its GF plugin's carriers, dreadnoughts, sky fortresses, a Mirage tank that hides as a tree and a hero tank that ranks itself up.
《FG铁锈联盟》经作者空中之主授权移植：整套重绘的军队——灰熊、光棱坦克、基洛夫空艇、爱国者导弹——以及 GF 插件的航母、无畏战舰、空中堡垒、会变成树的幻影坦克和能自己升级的英雄坦克。

FG Rusted League, ported from its Rusted Warfare build with its author's permission: the whole army redrawn in black and acid green — Grizzly and Prism tanks, Kirov airships, Patriot batteries — and its GF plugin's carriers, dreadnoughts, sky fortresses, a Mirage tank that hides as a tree and a hero tank that ranks itself up.

name: Hades Arsenal
冥府军械
Hades Arsenal
mods.author: 11的沧斯拉
description: Starships from the underworld's armoury: the Hades Star tier-5 battleship, the Ceasefire-class siege battleship, the Hades Hound storm fighter, and a strategic strike missile tower that fires thirty-two rockets a salvo.
来自冥府军械库的星舰：Hades Star 5级战斗舰、止战级攻坚战列舰、冥犬风暴舰，以及一次齐射三十二枚火箭的战略打击导弹塔。

Starships from the underworld's armoury: the Hades Star tier-5 battleship, the Ceasefire-class siege battleship, the Hades Hound storm fighter, and a strategic strike missile tower that fires thirty-two rockets a salvo.

name: Ironworks
铁工厂
Ironworks
mods.author: Steel Tide
description: A hover tank with its own art and sound, a turreted bunker, and a fourth level for the power plant line — one of each thing a mod can add.
一辆自带图像和音效的悬浮坦克、一座带旋转炮塔的碉堡，以及发电厂线的第四级——模组能加的每种东西各一个。
A hover tank with its own art and sound, a turreted bunker, and a fourth level for the power plant line — one of each thing a mod can add.

name: Rusted Expansion
铁锈扩展包
Rusted Expansion
mods.author: Steel Tide
description: An official tribute to a certain rusty little RTS a lot of us played on the bus before this one — the one where the money came in dollars and your side was green. Six of its classics, Tank, Heavy Tank, Helicopter, Bomber, Gun Boat and Battle Ship, repainted from memory, with their numbers brought across as near as the counter web allows.
向某款铁锈味十足、许多人上课时偷偷玩过的老牌手机 RTS 致敬的官方模组——就是那个钱按美元算、自己人是绿色的。它的六个经典单位：坦克、重型坦克、直升机、轰炸机、机枪艇、战列舰，凭记忆重新绘制，数值尽量按原样带过来。

An official tribute to a certain rusty little RTS a lot of us played on the bus before this one — the one where the money came in dollars and your side was green. Six of its classics, Tank, Heavy Tank, Helicopter, Bomber, Gun Boat and Battle Ship, repainted from memory, with their numbers brought across as near as the counter web allows.
